name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

<!--
Before filing:
- Search existing issues and check docs/analysis/ (especially the roadmap and the
  v1.0 release definition) — the item may already be planned, parked, or
  explicitly out of scope.
- The tool surface is deliberately small and curated: each tool wraps a real,
  verified capability rather than mirroring every Graph edge.
-->

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today? Describe
the operator workflow, not just the API call.

## Proposed capability

What should the server do? If it is a new tool, suggest a name following the
`facebook_<verb>_<noun>` convention and note whether it reads or writes.

## Tool area

Which area does this touch? (check one)

- [ ] Publishing (posts / photos / video / Reels / scheduling)
- [ ] Reading & insights
- [ ] Moderation (comments)
- [ ] Messaging
- [ ] Ads (1.1+, off by default)
- [ ] Core / config / transport / doctor
- [ ] Docs / developer experience

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you have tried or other designs you considered, and why they fall
short.

## Additional context

Links to the relevant Meta Graph API docs, screenshots, or anything else that
helps. If the capability spends money or is irreversible, note it — those go
through the out-of-band confirmation gate.
